## What's Changed
* fix: fit window to display before exclusive fullscreen by @Wyvest in https://github.com/notdevcody/pylon/pull/35
* fix: fall back to legacy GL context on drivers below 3.2 by @Wyvest in https://github.com/notdevcody/pylon/pull/37
* fix: prefer wayland on Crostini by @Wyvest in https://github.com/notdevcody/pylon/pull/34
* fix: warn when the driver lacks GL 1.3 and multitexture by @Wyvest in https://github.com/notdevcody/pylon/pull/42
* fix(mouse): map horizontal wheel to vertical on macOS (MC-121772) by @lunaynx in https://github.com/notdevcody/pylon/pull/41

* @lunaynx made their first contribution in https://github.com/notdevcody/pylon/pull/41
